technology_name: MUDRA PRABHA - Ultra-Compact Pocket-Sized Tool for Currency Validation and Denomination Identification
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Visually challenged or impaired individuals cannot reliably, safely, and discreetly identify distinct paper currency denominations in high-speed, everyday public trade settings.
description: A ultra-compact, pocket-sized currency validation tool designed with a structural slot guide, built-in optical sensors, and tactile output indicators that map paper currency dimension bounds and print patterns to accurately identify denominations.
applications: Assistive technology products for the blind, micro-wearable shopping tools, public banking accessibility kits, and specialized educational rehabilitation devices.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
